tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog nag po spyod pa'i sgrub thabs snying po bde 'jug bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañdzu badzrā ya/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa nag po spyod pa'i lugs kyi sgrub thabs snying po bde 'jug ces bya ba/ dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spros kun nyer zhi'i don dam 'od gsal lhan skyes lha yi 'jug ngogs der/ /sna tshogs snang stong kun rdzob sgyu ma 'khor lo lha yi dbang po'i gzhu| |bsdud cing spro ba'i bden gnyis rol pa skal bzang yid mig bdud rtsi'i bcud/ khyab bdag dpal ldan rigs kyi gtso bo 'khor lo sdom par phyag bgyid do/ /bdun lhag sum cu'i byang phyogs chos kyi sku/ /'og min dkyil 'khor na rol longs spyod rdzogs/ /'dzam gling gnas mchog dpal gyur sprul pa'i sku/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yis dge legs mdzod/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i lam gyi mchog brnyes pa'i/ /nag po spyod sogs grub chen mtha' dag dang*/ / dpal ldan bla mar spyi bos btud byas te/ /rgyal bas bskul nas brtul zhugs spyod pa yis/ /sbyar ba'i gzhung las bskyed rim lam gyi gnad/ / 'khrul bral snying po bsdus pa 'dir bshad kyi/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gros rtag tu grogs mdzad cing*/ lam 'dir mjug par 'dod rnams spro bar mdzod/ / 'di la gnyis/ bsam don lung rigs kyis gtan la dbab pa/ ngag don sdeb sbyor gyis tshig tu brjod pa'o/ / dang po la/ dgag bzhag gnyis kyi dang po la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi la gzhan lugs dgag pa gnyis las dang po ni/ kha cig na re/ lugs 'di bde mchog lugs gzhan phal cher dang bskyed rim kyi spyi'i chings mi 'dra zhing*/ 'di'i gzhung nas kyang ma bshad pas sngon du sgo gsum dag byed dang phung khams skye mched dang byin gyis rlabs pa mi dgos so zhe na/ de ni mi rigs te/ bskyed rim kyi chings lo dril dang mi mthun kyang*/ bde mchog rtsa bshad kyi rgyud la slob dpon 'dis kyang shin tu'ang brten zhing*/ rtsa rgyud gtso bor yang byed pas/

spyir rtsa rgyud kyi de nyid bcu bzhi tshang dgos la/ de'i phur bu dang gur la sogs pa'i de nyid du bshad pa bsrung 'khor gyi khongs sgo gsum dag byed sogs kyang 'dus pa'i phyir dang*/ mngon brjod kun spyod sogs nas de rnams nges par dgos par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na kha gcig de rnams byed pa byed kyang de rnams kyang bsrung 'khor gyi bar du tshogs bsog 'jug pa yang mi 'thad de/ /de rnams bsrung 'khor dang sbrel bar rigs pa'i shes byed med cing*/ rgya bod kyi mkhas mchog du mas mdzad kyang lu hi pa'i lugs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha gcig lu hi pa ltar 'di'i lugs la'ang dag byed byin brlabs dang bcas pa dang bsrung 'khor gyi mjug tu tshogs bsags byed pa'ang mi rigs te/ lu hi pa ltar bsrung 'khor gyi snang ba bsdud na de ltar byas pas ye shes kyi tshogs kyi mjug tu nā da 'jog pa sogs kyang bde bas shin tu legs na yang*/ 'di'i bzhed pa ni bsrung 'khor gyi snang ba mi bsdud par shin tu gsal te/ 'di'i dkyil chog tu/ lcags ri'i mthar thug pa yi bar| |rdo rje phreng bas yongs bskor zhing*/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor nang du yang*// rim gnyis thig ni gdab par bya/ /zhes dkyil 'khor gzhan gang du yang ma bshad pa'i rdor ra dang me ri'i bar du thig gnyis gsungs la/ rje btsun chen po grags rgyal gyi gsung gis/ 'dis dur khrod bstan zhes gsungs pa ni/ mi 'thad de/ rdor ra dang me ri'i bar du dur khrod yong mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /des na thig de gnyis ni bsrung 'khor gyi padma dang 'khor lo'i yin no zhes bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas gsung ba ltar yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'di'i sgrub thabs su dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa brjod/ /thams cad stong par rnam bsgoms te| |sna tshogs padmar nyi rdo rje'i/ /hūm̐ byung mkha' 'gro ma tshogs kyis/ /blo bzang gis ni phur sogs bya/

/zhes sogs sngon du tshogs bsags gsungs pas thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du gzhal yas khang bsgom pa yang lugs 'di'i khyad chos gcig yin no/ /de ltar na gang dag lo hi pa ltar lugs 'di la'ang bsrung 'khor la rdo rje'i rwa ba gru bzhi pa byed pa'ang 'thad par ma mthong ste/ de ltar yin na dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rwa zlum po'i nang du gru bzhi pa'i rdor rwa yang 'bri dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /yang gang dag bsrung 'khor gyi sngon du tshogs bsags byas nas ye shes kyi tshogs kyi mjug tu nā da nam mkhar bzhagade rjes bsrung 'khor bsgom par mdzad pa ni shin tu 'thad de/ 'di zhabs lugs dang bstun pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i tshe rang nyid he ru ka'i nga rgyal can du med na| oṃ gha gha sogs kyis khro bo bcu'am sgo mtshams ma rnams la bka' bsgo ba yang mi rigs shing*/ bsrung 'khor rtsa rgyud kyi sa chog gi skabs nas gsung pa de nyid mngon brjod sogs kyi bshad rgyud rnams su sgrub thabs kyi skabs su drangs la| rtsa rgyud du/ bdag nyid khrag 'thung dpal byas nas/ /de nas khrag 'thung dpal dran bya/ /'khor lo 'di yi snying khar dgod/ /de ltar go cha de bgos nas| |rwa ba rnams ni phyogs su bgod/ /'og tu yang ni mtshon cha dgod// 'khor lo bdag nyid mtshon cha mnyam/ /steng du mda' yi dra bar bya/ /slar yang bdag nyid mkha' spyod du/ /gur byas 'di ni go char 'gyur/ /de ltar go cha de bgos na/ /sum cu pas kyang mi phyed do/ /zhes sogs rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dgos par dngos su gsungs la/ sgrub thabs kyi tshe yang rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa khyad par med pa'i phyir zhes na'ang nā da la nga rgyal bzhag tu legs par rung ngo*| |gal te de ni sa chog gi skabs su gsungs pa yin pas 'dir shes byed du mi rung ngo zhe na/ de lta na rgyud sde phal cher las bsrung 'khor thams cad sa chog gi skabs su bstan pa sha stag yin pas sgrub thabs kyi bsrung 'khor gyi zur nas btsal dgos par gyur na de yang rnyed pa ma yin no/

/ dngos gzhi la rten dang brten pa la gzhan lugs dgag pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ kha cig lugs 'di la rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa nas bzungs te/ zhu ba glus bskul nas bzhengs pa'i bar du 'byung bzhi ri rab bsgom gyi/ gzhal yas khang mi bsgom te/ 'di'i sgrub thabs kyi mgor/ blo bzang gis ni phur sogs bya/ /ba lang gnas dang steng lding ba/ /lhag ma skam rtsa de nas ni/ /bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin bya*/ /mi phyed pa dang rus sbal lo| |phyag bzhi pa dang zhabs bzhi pa'o/ /zhes pa tsam las med cing*/ glus bskul gyi mjug tu*/ 'bar phreng rgya mtsho 'khor ba yi/ /kun nas sgo ni bzhi par blta| |zhes 'byung bas zhal yas khang ni mjug tu bsgom par bya ba yin zhe na/ de ni sgrub thabs 'di rtsa rgyud kyi tshig sor bzhag tu mdzad nas shin tu sbas te sngags dang lha dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa bzlog nas gsung pa shin tu brling ba zhig yin pas rtsa rgyud kyi mkha' 'gro'i brda tshig ma go na log rtogs kyi gzhi yod kyang de go ba la med de/ mi phyed pa zhes bya ba bgegs sogs phal pas bgrod dka' ba'i gzhal yas khang du gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta min na ri rab kyang mi bsgom par 'gyur te/ /bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin zhes pas ri rab ston pa'i don ma go na ri rab ston byed med pa'i phyir ro/ /der ma zad ba lang gnas dang steng lding dang lhag ma dang skam rtsa rnams kyi brda'i skad kyi sa chu me rlung ston pa ma gtogs/ rgyas bshad la 'byung bzhi'i ming yang med pas de rnams mi 'dod dgos so/ /'og gi kun nas sgo bzhi pa sogs kyis mngal skyes kyi rten ston pas na sgrub byed kyang shin tu 'khrul lo/ / skabs 'dir slob dpon ka lā ka dang*/ nyin byed rdo rje dang rin chen rdo rje sogs 'byung ba thams cad 'dus pa las zhes pa tsam rgyu mtshan du mdzad nas 'byung bzh-i gyur nas sna tshogs rdo rjer byas pa'i steng du gzhal yas khang bsgom par bzhed pa ni/

dus 'khor 'grel chen las 'byung bzhi ri rab kyi steng du gzhal yas khang bsgom pa ma rgyud kyi khyad chos kyi gtso bo gcig tu gsungs pa dang 'gal la/ slob dpon 'dis dkyil chog tu ri yi rtse dang ge sar dang*/ /sna tshogs padma ā li dang*/ /zhes gsungs pa dang yang 'gal lo/ /'phags pas 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung tshar gcig yongs su gyur nas de rting rlung nas bgrangs pa'i lugs bzlog tshar gcig bskyed pa'i steng du ri rab bsgom pa la'ang shes byed med cing*/ dus 'khor dang khyad chos mthun par khas len dgos par 'gyur la/ de lta na 'grel chen dang 'gal lo/ /lam ka rgyal bzangs kyis 'byung bzhi'i steng du kaṃ las thod pa'am rus sbal de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje dang padma'i steng du ri rab bsgom par bshad pa ni spyi dang bye brag gi rgyud dang*/ khungs thub kyi gzhung gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i rang bzo'o/ /rus sbal zhes pa'i rgyud tshig ni brda'i skad de/ rus sbal nang gi sems can dang phyi'i khog pa gnyis lhan cig tu skye bar ltar/ mngon byang lnga las rten dang brten pa gcig car 'grub pa'i don no/ /'on kyang bde mchog gi zhal yas khang bskyed chog la de kho nar ma nges te/ mngon brjod bla ma las/ de yi steng du bsam pa ni| |bruṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo mchog /de yongs gyur las rtag pa ste/ khang pa brtsegs pa'i rnam par bsam/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ /zhes sogs bruṃ dang 'khor lo las byung ba'i rnam snang yongs su gyur nas gzhal yas khang bskyed par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'dir yang mar do'i rjes 'brang dag mi phyed pa dang rus sbal ltar bskyed pa byed mod na'ang*| sa skya pa dang bu ston gyis mdzad pa ltar mngon brjod kyi lugs byas na'ang 'gal ba med cing slob dpon 'dis bskyed rim kyi 'gros gtso che ba rnams ye shes zhabs lugs kyi rjes su 'brang bar snang la de'i sgrub thabs kun bzang las bhruṃ las 'khor lo las byung rig bcas pa'i/

/rnam snang yan lag rdzogs las yang dag byung*/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no/ /gzhal yas khang gi rgya khyon gyi tshad ni dkyil 'khor dngos kyi nyis 'gyur me ri tshun la yod pa thig skud thung ba'i lugs yin te/ /sdom 'byung du thig gi tshan pa drug cu bzhi| |kun tu 'khor lo'i mthar thug bar/ /zhes 'od phreng gi bar la cha phran re bzhi par gsungs la/ slob dpon 'dis kyang de'i rjes su 'brang bar gsal te| grwa nas thig gis bskor ba dag /rta babs kyi ni gnas su bshad/ /ces mda' yab kyi zur gyi rtse nas zlum thig bskor ba rta babs kyi gzhir gsungs la de la rta babs sgo tshad gcig dang rwa rtse sgo tshad gcig las lhag pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas de'i bar du rta babs spangs la sgo tshad gsum rwa rtse dang bcas pa shong bar bzhed pa ni panṭi ta'i bya ba ches mang pas cung zad dpyad pa ma mdzad par zad do/ /de ltar na rta babs sgo tshad gcig ma yang 'di'i khyad chos so/ /de'i phyir dur khrod kyang bsrung 'khor gyi nang du mi 'ong bar sdom 'byung gi rgyud tshig des grub pas sdom 'byung gi rdo rje ra ba'i nang du ni/ /dur khrod brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /zhes pa'ang 'gyur skyon yin pas rdo rje ra ba'i nang du ste/ /dur khrod brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /zhes bsgyur na legs te rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ rdo rje ra ba'i phyi rol du/ /shing sogs dur khrod brgyad po yin/ /zhes pa dang mthun shing rgya gar gyi mkhas grub du mas kyang de bzhin du mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta na yang spyir dur khrod bsrung 'khor gyi nang du byar mi rung ba kho na ma yin te/ man ngag snye mar rdo rje ra ba'i nang du dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i chos 'byung chu skyes dang sna tshogs rdo rje la gnas pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa zhes dang kyai rdor dka' 'grel mu tig phreng bar/

rā ba'i nang du dur khrod brgyad la sogs pa phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su bsam nas zhes gsungs shing rgya bal gyi ras bris rnying ma rnams dang bod kyi yig cha rnying pa du mar de ltar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ kha cig lugs 'di la dur khrod med par 'dod pa'ang mi rigs te/ mngon dkyil gnyis su gsal bar ma byung yang 'di'i sbyin bsreg tu gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ rigs pas kyang thob pa'i phyir ro| |dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mdog ni dā ri ka pas shar phyogs su ni sngon po che| |lhor ni ser te nub ni dmar/ /byang ni ljang khus rnam par mdzes/ /zhes sogs dang gtso bo'i zhal gyi mdog dang phyogs mdog mthun par dus 'khor nas gsungs pa sogs kyi rigs bsgres nas byed pa mang du byung na'ang*/ dwa ri ka pa'i gzhung 'di ni/ dbus kyi sna tshogs padma'i mdog ston par snang ste/ de ka'i mjug tu/ lte ba ljang zhing ge sar ser/ /sna tshogs mdog pad gri gug sngo// zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /lam ka rgyal bzangs kyis gtso bo'i zhal gyi mdog tu byed pa yang*/ lo hi pa'i lugs la mi bde ba med na'ang/ lugs 'di gzhan la sbyar du mi rung ngo*/ /'di'i mngon dkyil du ni gsal kha ma bshad kyang rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ /phyi rol shar ni shin tu dkar/ /lho ni ser po nub ni dmar// byang ni ljang khur gsungs pa ste/ /de lta 'di yis cho ga yis/ /sangs rgyas bzhi yi gdan du gnas/ /zhes dang sdom 'byung du'ang shar phyogs su ni dkar po che// lho ni ser po yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi cha ni dmar po te/ /byang ni ljang khu yang dag ldan/ /dbus kyi sa yi cha dag ni/ /inṭa nī la'i 'od 'phro ba'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ 'di'i dkyil chog las/ inṭa nī la'i sa gzhi la/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid bsam/ /zhes dbus sngon por gsungs pa'i shugs la bshad rgyud de gnyis kyi rjes su 'brang bar go bas lugs 'di la dkyil 'khor gyi shar nag por byed pa thams cad khegs so/

/rtsig pa lnga'i mdog kyang*/ lam kas zhal mdog g.yas bskor rim bzhin phyi nas sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba byas shing*/ nang dkar ba ni gtso mo'i rigs bdag rnam snang yin pa la bsams so/ /'on kyang rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ dkar po ser po dmar po ljang*| |kun gyi nang du nag po ste/ /rdul tshon rnams ni rim bzhin bri/ /zhes dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun par gsungs la/ de'i rjes su dā ri ka pa dang pradzñā rakṣi ta dang bhu wa blo ldan/ bod kyi rje btsun grags rgyal sogs kyis kyang 'brangs pas na 'phags pa rin po ches nang nas nag dkar ser dmar ljang bar gsungs pa ni rigs pa dang mi ldan no/ /dkyil chog rdor phreng du phyi nas ljang dkar dmar ser sngo bar bshad pa ni dam tshig sku gsung thugs bde chen gtso bo rnams kyi mdog dang mthun par mdzad nas thugs 'khor gtso bo dang rigs gcig tu bsdus pa te/ skabs der 'di gnyis bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi thig gi zhib cha dang thog 'bugs la sogs pa ni rgyas par gzhan du 'chad par 'dod pas/ de dag dang mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis bshad pa las rtogs par bya'o|

| rten pa la gzhan lugs dgag pa ni/ kha cig rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yang 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhin du cho ga gsum skyed byed pa mi 'thad de/ de lta na ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi mngon byang lnga skyed lugs 'di la med par 'gyur la/ de ltar rtsa rgyud kyi de nyid bcu bzhi'i ā li kā li zhes brjod nas zhes pa'i ā li kā li'i de nyid rdzogs pa med par 'gyur bas slob dpon 'dis 'khrul pa cher mdzad par 'gyur bas so/ kha cig rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku mdog yang 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa ji bzhin du 'dod pa'ang mi rigs te/ sku mdog dkar po khro bo che| |rdo rje dril bus sku la 'khyud/ /ces pa nas yan lag kha ṭwaṃ ga dang sbyar/ / thod pa mchod yon snod du ni/ /zhes sku mdog dkar po dang phyag bzhi par gsungs pa las dngos su 'gongs pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhal mdog dang phyag mtshan la/ kha cig 'di'i sgrub thabs su dngos su bstan pa rnams| sngags rnams bzlog ste bstan pa 'dra bar sbas pa yin pas lo dril ji lta ba bzhin du byed pa ni/ slob dpon 'di yang bzhed pa yin te/ /'di'i dkyil chog gi mdun bskyed sgrub pa'i skabs dang 'dis mdzad pa'i bde mchog dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs rnams su lo dril ji bzhin bshad la/ gzhan yang slob dpon a bha ya dang mai tri ba sogs kyis bde mchog gi sgrub thabs zur pa mdzad pa rnams su'ang de bzhin du zhe gcig par 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ mar do'i rjes 'brang rnams kyis kyang 'di'i sgrub thabs mchod brjod du/ g.yas rnams rtse gsum gri gug dgra sta ḍā ma ru bsnams he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes 'gyur bcos nas 'di dag mas rim gis rtogs pa bya ba yin no zhes bzhed pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'o na rgyud kun spyod kyi le'u drug pa las/ phyag gnyis yang dag 'khyud pa dang*| |gnyis kyi glang po'i lpags pa 'dzin/

/dgra sta mdung rtse gsum gri gug/ ḍā ma ru ni g.yas pas 'phyar/ kha ṭwaṃ ga dang thod pa'i khrag /zhags pa mgo bo 'phyar ba ni/ /g.yon pa nyid du yang dag bshad/ /ces pa'ang gzhan du bshad dgos par 'gyur te/ mngon brjod dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs du ma dang ma mthun pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du lam ka rgyal bzangs kyis kyang 'di dang mthun par bshad cing*/ bod kyi snga phyi'i mkhas pa phal cher gyis kyang de bzhin du bshad la/ khyad par gyi mdog ni sgrub thabs nyid nas bsnyon med du gsungs pas de dag la dngos su 'gal bar su zhig gis nus/ des na rang rgyud bskyed rim gyi lam gyi sbyong ba'i bdag bskyed la de ltar mi byed pa'i mdun bskyed la zhal phyag khyad par 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig slob dpon 'dis gzigs pa'am/ yang na rgyud tha dad pa gnyis ka nyams len du mdzad par bzhed pa yin te/ de ltar ma yin na mdun bskyed kyi skabs su lha mo bcu gnyis kyang phyag bzhi mar gsungs pas de bzhin du bdag bskyed la'ang rtag tu 'dod dgos par 'gyur ro| |de'i phyir/ bdag mdun zhal phyag mi 'dra ba'i 'dam nga can yang 'di'i khyad chos gcig go /yang 'phags pas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i skabs su/ lus la go cha dang snying po nye snying gi sngags 'god pa gnyis ka nyer sgrub tu byas/ ye shes pa 'jug pa sgrub par byas pa ni/ gzhung nyis nas/ go cha 'god pa dang*/ sngags 'god pa gnyis nyer sgrub dang sgrub par mdzad nas/ ye shes dgug zhugs yan chod sgrub chen la dngos su sbyar ba dang 'gal lo/ kha cig na/ re 'di'i lugs kyi lha gtso 'khor rnams g.yon brkyang du bya ste/ 'di'i sgrub thabs kyi 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skabs su/ g.yon brkyangs pa yi stabs kyis bzhugs/ /zhes dang 'khor thams cad kyi rgyan la sogs pa'i khyad chos thun mong ba brjod pa'i mjug tu'ang*/ g.yon brkyang pa yi goms pas gnas|

zhes gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'di la bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung gis/ gzhung gong ma rgya dpe la g.yas brkyang du yod cing*/ glog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis g.yas brkyang du bsgyur la 'di'i dkyil chog las kyang*/ g.yas brkyang pa yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs dar dpyangs can/ /zhes pa dang 'gal zhing*/ g.yon brkyang gi gar byed na'ang 'jigs byed dus mtshan gnyis ka gnon pa mi bde bas gtso bo g.yas brkyang yin la/ gzhung 'og ma ni shes rab brtsegs kyis sngar ltar g.yas brkyang du bsgyur mod/ rdo rjai mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs las kyang g.yon brkyang du bshad la| de nas nyi ma la bzhugs gar dang bcas/ /zhes gsungs pas g.yon brkyang gi gar stabs su gsal mod/ 'on kyang rgya dpe'i sham rnyed na brtag par bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /'di la'ang snga ma'i rigs pa rnams ni phyi ma la'ang mtshungs te/ 'di'i dkyil chog tu/ dam tshig 'khor lor zhugs nas ni/ / gnyis med ye shes bsgom par bya/ /he ru ka dpal la sogs kun/ /g.yas brkyang pa yis gdan la bzhugs/ /zhes 'khor phal cher la'ang g.yas brkyang du gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ 'khor rnams gar stabs su bzhugs pa'ang*/ sgrub thabs nyid kyi g.yon brkyang pa'i goms pas bzhugs zhes pa'i goms pa zhes pas bkag la/ 'di'i gtso bo'i phyag mtshan sogs kun spyod dang bstun zhing*/ rgyud de las kyang*/ shrī he ru ka la sogs/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi gdan dang ldan// zhes dang*/ khwa gdong ma la sogs pa bzhi/ /sgo kun mngon par bkab byas te/ / g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis su/ /ro mnan pa yi gdan dang ldan/ /de bzhin gshin rje sreg ma sogs/ /zhes gsungs shing khyad par nag po dam tshig rdo rjes| |slob dpon gzhan gyi lugs dag gis/ /g.yas pa'i zhabs ni bskum par 'dod/ /blo bzang kha cig gar yang byed/ /gnyis ka 'dod pa ma yin te/ / zhes bshad pa'i slob dpon gzhan ni nag po spyod pa las gzhan du gsal te/

'dis nag po spyod pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas sdom pa bshad pa zhes pa'i gzhung 'di mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs su kha cig mngal skyes kyi gtso bo 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra bar mdzad pa ni mi 'thad de/ mngal skyes kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog yod pa'i gsang 'dus gnyis dang dus 'khor dang sampu ṭi'i rdor sems gshin rje gshed skor sogs thams cad du/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gang bzhugs kyi 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa de'i rigs bdag mi skyod pa'am 'od dpag med sogs rigs bdag so so ba re mngal skyes kyi gtso bor byas/ de phyir spros dkyil gyi gtso bo la zhugs pas/ gtso bo de lus dkyil kha dog 'gyur ba dang*/ zhi khro'i nyams 'gyur ba sogs 'byung ba ni gzhi'i lus dang sems la sogs pa'i sbyong byed dang*/ bde mchog sogs lus sems gang yang mi 'gyur ba rnams de bzhin nyid kyi sbyong byed du 'gro ba bu ston rin po ches gsungs pa ni rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang mkhas pa des kyang mngal du lha rnams sa bon las dran rdzogs su bskyed nas gsal mi 'debs par/ mngal nas phyung ste phyi dkyil la 'khod pa dang lus dkyil cig car du gsal 'debs pa ni/ rtsa ba'i grub mtha' snga ma dang 'gal te/ gsang 'dus la sogs par mngal du dkyil 'khor rgyas par bsgoms nas phyi dkyil la bkod pa tsam gyis chog pa'i rnam bzhag 'byung ba dang*/ khyad par dus 'khor la mngal du lha rim gyis bskyed nas rim gyis spro ba sbyang gzhi dang zhib tu sbyar ba'i phyir ro/ /des na mngal skyes dang lus dkyil lhan cig tu gsal la rgyas par bsgoms nas mngal skyes phyi dkyil la 'god pa la nyes pa med do/ /sa skya pas mngal skyes rdo rje'i lam nas rang gi lus kyi cha de dang der drangs pa'i lus kyi cha rnams su reg pa'i rkyen gyis lus dkyil gsar du 'grub par bshad pa la|

de mi rigs te lus gdod ma nas dkyil 'khor du grub grub pa gsal 'debs pa yin gyi/ rkyen gzhan gyis gsar du bskyed pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes khyed rang gis dgag pa mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang lus dkyil 'khor du grub grub par khas len na jo nang pa'i grub mtha' yang mi khegs la/ rtsa khams lha'i rang bzhin du bzhed bzhin du lus dkyil sgom pa'i tshe rtsa khams de dag la lha rnams 'god par mdzad pa'ang bdag gi blo la 'thad par ma gyur to// 'on kyang bla ma snga ma dag gis bskyed rim gang la yang sku gsum lam khyer gyi rnam gzhag ma mdzad cing*/ la lar bar do'i mtshon byed re tsam byas kyang 'chi ba sbyong byed gtan med du song mod/ mkhas pa'i dbang po khyod kyis de dag legs par bkod pa ni rnam dpyod ldan pa mtha' dag mgu bar byed cing*/ spyir bla med kyi rgyud sde'i dgongs pa dang*/ khyad par bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi de nyid bcu bzhi'i/ rgyu sogs stong pa sngon 'gro bas/ /zhes pa'i rgyud don legs par rnyed pa'i man ngag yin pas bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo| |spyir gyi bskyed rim la sku gsum lam khyer gal che ba'i rgyu mtshan mang du bshad rgyu yod mod kyi 'dir yi ge mang bar 'gyur bas bzhag go /'o na lung 'di gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs la gtso cher rten na/ de'i sgrub thabs kun bzang las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sems nyid ni/ /'od ldan ho dang spel ba cho ga bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pas bar sṛd mtshon byed de bzhin du byed dam zhe na ma yin te/ spyir bskyed rim gyi 'gros de dang bstun yang*/ rtsa rgyud kyi de nyid bcu bzhi las ma 'gongs pa gcig dgongs la/ rtsa rgyud du/ rgyu sogs stong pa sngon 'gro bas/ /'jug pa sgra la sogs pa yang*/ /zhes bshad la/ sgra ni nā da la gsal bar gsungs pas na bde mchog bskyed rim gyi bar do sbyong na nā da la byed pa khyad par med pa'i phyir ro/

/ gnyis pa rang gi lugs bzhag pa ni/ spyir bskyed rim phyings*/ rtsa rgyud du| gos dang phyag rgya lnga la sogs/ /shes rab yan lag phur bu gur/ /ā li kā li zhes brjod nas/ /rgyu sogs stong pa sngon 'gro bas/ /'jug pa sgra la sogs pa nas/ /ji srid bsdus pa'i sbyor ldan pa/ /bdud rtsi tshim byed mya ngan 'das| |lag pa'i mchod pa dbang bskur dang*/ /go cha chen pos rnam par brgyan| |sngags rnams kun gyis mchod par bya/ /de ltar de nyid bcu bzhi ni/ / mdor bsdus nas ni brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa la tshul bzhi ka la sbyar ba'i bshad pa mang du yod mod/ bskyed rim la sbyar ba phal cher mthun/ gos dngos dang gos kyi skad dod wā sa na gnas la'ang 'jug pas/ ri bo tshang tshing sman ljongs sam/ /chu bo chen po'i ngogs dag dang*/ gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod du/ /der ni dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bya/ /zhes rtsa rgyud du gsungs pa la sgrub par bya zhes pa'ang 'thob pas de lta bu dang*/ 'di'i dkyil chog tu bshad pa lta bu'i gnas kyi de nyid dang*/ kun spyod du/ mgur chu gdu bu gdub skor dang*/ / spyi bor nor bu'i rgyan dang ni*/ /mchod phyir thogs dang thal ba ste/ /phyag rgya drug du rab tu grags/ /pha rol phyin drug rnams dag pas/ /phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa yin/ /zhes pa'i thal ba ma gtogs pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang des mtshon pa'i phyag rgya drug pa dang gzhan yang kha ṭāṃ ga dang cang te'u la sogs pa'i bsten bya dang bza' bya'i dam tshig gi rdzas bsag pa'i yo byad kyi de nyid dang*/ shes rab yan lag ni shes rab ma dngos de'i dod kha ṭāṃ ga'aṃ slob dpon 'di'i dkyil chog ltar na ro gdan te/ shes rab yan lag gi de nyid dang*/ phur bu gur gyi mtshon pa'i bgegs bzlog byed/ sgo gsum skye mched sogs kyi byin rlabs bsrung 'khor gyi de nyid dang*/ ā li kā li mngon byang lnga'i ye shes gnyis la sogs pa dbyangs gsal gyi de nyid dang*/

ru sogs stong pa nyid ni/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi pa'i don sngon du bsgom pas yid dag pa'ang ston la/ he ru ka gsum gyi don dran pa'i gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ de gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum du bsgyur ba la 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros nas sa gsum de dang der byas pa snyoms par bzhugs pas zhu nas de gsum dang*/ de gsum yang rim gyis dang hūm̐ yang rim gyis bsdus pa'i lo hi pa ltar na snang ba thams cad dang*/ 'di la rnal 'byor pa rang gi snang ba rim gyis bsdus pa'i 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba stong pa'i de nyid dang*/ 'jug pa sgra ni de'i mthar bar do longs skur 'khyer ba'i nā da nam mkhar 'jog pa nas lo hi pa ltar na zla ba dkar dmar gyi dbus su de bzhugs pa'i bar dang 'di la rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhal du de zhugs pa'i bar sgra sogs kyi de nyid dang*/ bsdus pa'i sbyor ba la rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa rnams na mi mthun pa 'ga' re snang na'ang lo dril ltar na lha dam tshig sems dpa' dang ye shes sems dpa' dbyer med du sbyor ba'i bar dang*| 'di la lha dang byang phyogs dbyer med du sbyor ba'i bar zhes gsung yang*/ gzhung gi rim pa tsam ma gtogs byang phyogs dang sbyor na dgug gzhug dbang bskur sogs kyi gong du mi rung ba'i shes byed mi snang bas/ 'og bdud rtsi tshim byed la thug thug gi dbang dang go cha'i skor ma gtogs pa rnams 'dis bsdus pa ni bsdus sbyor gyi de nyid dang*/ bdud rtsi myang ba mtshon pa'i phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rnams bdud rtsi tshim byed kyi de nyid dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba dang*/ lo hi pa ltar na rnal 'byor pa chen po rnams ni myang 'das kyi de nyid dang*/ go cha snga phyi dang*/ gnas nyer bzhi byin gyis rlob pa rnams go cha chen po'i de nyid dang*/

lag pa mchod pa ni mdun bskyed maṇḍal gyi dkyil 'khor tshab ma ste/ lag mchod kyi de nyid dang*/ smin byed kyi dbang dang*/ sgrub thabs kyi dbang bskur ni dbang bskur gyi de nyid dang*/ lha rnams gsal 'debs kyi mtshan nas brjod pa ni sngags mchod kyi de nyid ste/ bcu bzhi po 'di rnams gzhung gzhan du byas/ dang po rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum gyis sems can la dbang bskur/ de rting de 'od du zhu ba glus bskul/ de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa'i 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi ldan du bsgom pa/ des dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog sprul pa'i phyi nang gi lha thams cad la bsnyen bsgrub bzhi tshar gcig sbyor ba/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sngon du 'chi srid dang*/ bar srid sbyong byed kyi rnal 'byor byed pa rnams ni gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs la brten nas 'don pa bsgyur ba yin te/ tshul 'di ni ma rgyud spyi dang bde mchog gzhan la ma grags pa'i bskyed rim gyis bshad srol rmad du byung ba zhig ste/ de yang slob dpon 'dis rdzogs rim gyi bstan bcos gsang ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal bar byed pa las/ dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lam 'di ni/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi gtso bo ste/ /rim pa gnyis kyi ngo bo la/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa lhag yid 'ong*/ /zhes gsang 'dus kyi bskyed rdzogs gtso bor mdzad la/ gsang 'dus lugs gnyis kyi nang nas kyang ye shes zhabs lugs la dgyes par gsal zhing*/ spyir yang*/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du ni/ phyis kyi paṇa chen dang grub chen mtha' dag la ye shes zhabs lugs grags che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no/ /de ltar yid ches pa nges pa bskyed pa'i thabs gtso che ba rnams brjod nas/ da ni/ gnyis pa ngag 'don sdeb sbyor gyi tshig tu brjod pa ni/ ngag 'don nyung ba la dga' ba shin tu mang bas de dag gi ngor mdor bsdus te brjod par bya ste/
slob dpon 'di yang don 'di la dgyes par go ba'i phyir ro/ des na 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ ri bo tshang tshing sman ljongs dang*/

/chu bo chen po'i ngaugs dang ni/ /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod sogs/ /mtshan nyid kun ldan gnas su 'gyur/ /skra grol gcer bu thal bas byugs/ /phyag rgya drug dang thod pa'i snod| |tshang skud rdor dril cang te'u/ /shes rab bde ster bu mo dang*/ /ro gdan kha ṭwaṃ ga la sogs/ /nyer mkho kun dang ldan par gyur/ /rang nyid dpal ldan he ru ka /sku mdog sngon po rdor dril 'dzin/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rkyang bzhugs| |rdo rje phag mo rab 'jigs ma/ /sku mdog dmar mo rdo rje dang*/ / thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ /oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shungnghaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shangngho3 haṃ/ dam rdzas snod dang bcas pa stong par gyur/ /stong pa'i ngang las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /sngon po gzhu dbyibs rgyal mtshan mdzes pas mtshan/ /de steng me dkyil dmar po gru gsum pa/ /'bar ba'i me yis mtshan pa'i steng du yang*/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mi mgo'i sgyid bu gsum/ /de steng ā las thod pa dkar po yi/ /nang gi shar lho nub byang dbus rnams su/ /bi ra shu ma mu las rim bzhin du/ /dri chen rakta khu ba sha chen dang*/ /dri chu rnams las bruṃ aṃ dzrīṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ /'og gi shar lho nub byang dbus rnams su'ang*/ /go ku ha da na las ba lang dang*/ khyi dang glang chen rta dang mi yi sha / kun gyi steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ rnams ni/ /dkar dmar sngo ba steng du brtsegs par gyur/ /thugs kha'i 'od kyis rlung g.yos me sbar bas/ /rdzas rnams sbyangs nas zhu zhing khol ba yi/ /rlangs pas 'bru gsum bskyod pa'i 'od zer gyis/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes bdud rtsi dang*/ /sa gsum bdud rtsi yig 'bru gsum la bstim/ /rim bzhin zhu ba rdzas dang 'dres pa las/

/zag med bde ster bdud rtsi 'bar bar gyur/ /oṃ khaṇḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ mchod rdzas snod dang bcas pa stong nyid las/ /kaṃ las rgya chen thod pa'i snod rnams su/ /hūm̐ las lha rdzas mchod yon la sogs pa// ma lus mchod pa'i sprin gyis khyab pa ni/ /ngo bo bde stong rnam pa mchod pa'i rdzas| |byed las zag med bde bas mnyes par gyur/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /theg pa gsum po thams cad dang*/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo lha dbang mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la| |rtag tu skyabs su mchi bar bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ / bdag ni he ru kar gyur nas/ /sems can thams cad he ru ka'i/ /go 'phangs mchog la dgod par bgyi/ /rang gi spyi bo rdor sems yab yum ni/ /dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril can/ /ye shes dgug gzhug dbang bskur rgyas btab gyur/ /thugs kha'i hūm̐ mthar yig brgyas bskor ba las/ /don gnyis cher byas bdud rtsi'i rgyun chen babs/ /dri ma kun sbyangs bde chen 'bar bar gyur/ /oṃ badzra he ru ka bla ma bdag ni sogs/ dri ma kun byang rang la dbyer med gyur/ /shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni bkod dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /shrī he ru kaḥ.a haṃ/ rang nyid he ru ka ru lhag par gsal/ /oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na| pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ kṣaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags phreng g.yon bskor lan gsum gyis/ lte bar 'khod las 'khor lo gsum gyi tshogs| |rna bug g.yas nas phyir 'phros bgegs kun bskrad/ /slar 'dus g.yon nas zhugs pa sngags la thim/

/dpral bar bruṃ dkar rnam snang rang bzhin te/ /lte bar aṃ ser rdo rje nyi ma'i dngos/ /mgrin par hriḥdamar padma gar dbang ste/ /long bur ho ljang rdo rje rgyal po'i dngos/ /snying la hūm̐ dkar rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /spyi gtsug he nag he ru ka dpal dngos/ /mig la oṃ dkar gti mug rdo rje ste/ /rna bar hūm̐ nag zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna la traṃ ser ser sna rdo rje ste| |lce rtsar aṃ dmar 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ dpral bar khaṃ ljang phrag dog rdo rje ste| |snying la haṃ dkar dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /lte ba sa la laṃ ser ltung byed ma/ / snying kha chu la maṃ nag gsod byed ma/ /mgrin pa me la pam̐ dmar 'gugs byed ma// dpral ba rlung la taṃ ljang gar dbang ma/ /gsang gnas mkha' la padma dra ba'i dngos| khaṃ yig dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ /rang gi snying khar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig sngo skya'i 'od kyis bla ma dang*/ rgyal ba 'khor bcas 'khor lo sdom pa'i lhar/ /spyan drangs mdun du mngon sum zhugs par gyur/ /gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas/ /skad cig gis ni thob 'gyur ba/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku| |rdo rje can gyi zhabs la 'dud/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud| |gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing*/ /'dus dang dur khrod gnas pa yi| dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang phyug ma/ /kun la bdag ni gus phyag 'tshal/ /shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā dyāṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ dī paṃ| gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapda pra tī tstsha swāhā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/tshogs zhing dgyes nas rang la thim par gyur/ /ngo bo nyid dang bral phyir stong pa ste/ /rang bzhin rgyu dang bral bas mtshan ma med/ /rtog pa rnam dang bral phyir dngos rnams kun/

/ma lus smon pa las ni nges par grol/ /oṃ shū n+ya tā zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ yo ga shud dho dang*| oṃ badzra shungnghaḥ sarba dharmā badzra shungngho3 haṃ/ snang ba thams cad bsdus pa'i 'od gsal las/ /bar srid nā da phra mo gyen 'greng ba/ /dkar dmar chags pa'i mdangs can nam mkhar 'khod/ /rang gi 'og tu sna tshogs padma dang*/ /nyi mar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po yi/ /lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ /'og kun sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ /oṃ me dī ni badzrir bha wa badzra bandha hūm̐/ khor yug rdo rje padma 'khor lo yi/ /ra ba zlum po gsum gyis legs par bskor// oṃ badzra padma tsakra pra kā ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ steng kun rdo rje'i gur gyis khyab par gyur/ / oṃ badzra pañtsa ra hūm̐ paṃ hūm̐/ de nang rdo rje'i bla res mkha' ngos khebs/ /oṃ badzra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ steng 'og mda' yi dra ba 'phro bar gyur/ /oṃ badzra sa ra dzā la hūm̐ saṃ traṃ/ phyi rol rdo rje'i me 'od sna lnga pa/ /g.yon bskor bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar bar gyur| |oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ suṃ bha ni nas/ badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngags de phyi rol 'phros las skad cig gis/ /shar dang steng du kha gdong nag mo gnyis| |nub dang 'og tu khyi gdong dmar mo gnyis/ /lho byang phag dang 'ug gdong ser dang ljang*/ /me dang srin po rlung dang dbang ldan du/ /gshin rje brtan ma gshin rje pho nya ma/ /gshin rje mche ba gshin rje 'joms ma rnams/ /rang gi g.yas g.yon phyogs kyi phyed gzugs can/ /bcu car zhal gcig phyag gnyis drag mo'i gzugs/ /g.yas pas thod pa g.yon pas phur bu 'dzin/ /sprul pa dpag med phyogs bcur 'phros pa yis/ /byang chub sgrub la 'tshe ba'i bgegs rnams kun/ /bkug nas ra ba'i phy-i rol hūm̐ yig las/ /grub pa'i khron pa rnams su bcug pa rnams/ /khro mo rnams kyis phur bus gzir ba las/

/'od gsal bde chen ngang du zhugs par gyur/ /oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣtaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭaḥ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī la ya badzra dha ro ā dzñā pā ya ti/ sarba duṣtaṃ/ bighā kā ya wāktsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ badzra mudga ra badzra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ rdo rje ra ba'i nang du chos 'byung cher/ /yam̐ sngon las byung rlung dkyil gzhu lta bu/ /raṃ dmar las byung me dkyil gru gsum dmar/ /baṃ dkar las byung chu dkyil zlum po dkar/ / laṃ ser las byung sa dkyil gru bzhi ser/ /suṃ las lhun po rin chen bzhi'i rang bzhin| |gru bzhi rtse mo brgyad mtshan de stengs su/ /paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab stong ldan/ /de steng hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje yi/ /lte bar brum̐ dang 'khor lo las byung ba'i/ /rnam snang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /'khor lo dril bu 'dzin pa yongs gyur nas/ /thar pa chen po'i pho brang gzhal med khang*/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi yis brgyan/ /phyi nas dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba yi| |rtsig pa lnga ldan rin chen pha gu dang*/ /dra ba dra phyed shar bu mda' yab can| |gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan rnga yab dang*/ /me long zla phyed me tog phreng ba sogs/ /rgyan mang bye bas mkha' ngos rnam par bkra/ /zla phyed rdo rje nor bus mtshams kun mdzes/ /seṅge glang po shang shang te'u dang*/ /ri dwags chos kyi 'khor lo gzi 'od 'bar/ /'od zer phreng ba'i phy-i rol khor yug la/ /gtum drag la sogs 'jigs rung dur khrod brgyad/ /drag shul ro langs keng rus ha ha rgod/ /gcan gzan gnod sbyin srin po ca co 'don/ /rig 'dzin grub pa dam tshig spyod pa'i tshogs/ /gcer bu rgod cing bcom ldan 'das la blta/ /de dag rnams na shing dang phyogs skyong dang*/ /zhing skyong klu dang chu sprin mchod rten dang*/

/ ri dang grub chen re re gnas pa yi/ /ngo mtshar dpag yas dngos grub sgrub pa'i gnas| |dman pas bgrod par dka' bas bskor bar gyur/ /gzhal yas khang gi nang gi steng 'og ni/ /shar dkar byang ljang nub dmar lho ser zhing*/ / dbus kyi sa gzhi inṭa nī la'i mdog /rtsig 'gram lha snam dkar pos bskor ba'i nang*/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo dkar dmar sngo/ /'khor lo padma rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor/ /dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad ni/ /gri gug gis bskor bde chen 'khor lo'o/ /'khor lo bzhi yi 'tshams rnams brgyad brgyad kyi| |ka bas mdzes par btegs pa'i gdung zlum ni/ /rim pa bzhi pa je mthor gyur pa'i rtser/ /rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa'o/ /padma'i lte bar dbyangs dkar so gnyis dang*/ /gsal byed dmar po brgyad cus yongs gyur nas| |zla ba yongs rdzogs dkar dmar mdangs chags pa/ /bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gyur pa la/ /mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams// gsal gdangs gzugs brnyan tsam du shar ba ni/ /a ā nas aṃ aḥrnams g.yon bskor dang/ /slar yang a ā nas aṃ aḥgayas bskor te dkar po'i rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de'i phyi rol du ka kha ga gha nga nas sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥrnams g.yas bskor dang*/ slar yang ka nas kṣaḥrnams g.yon bskor te dmar po rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de ltar 'khor ba'i dbyangs dang zla ba yi// dkar cha me long lta bu'i ye shes te/ /gsal byed dmar cha mnyam nyid ye shes so| |zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ dang aṃ las ni/ /rdo rje thod pa hūm̐ dang aṃ gyis mtshan| |'od zer 'phrau ba sor rtog ye shes te/ /de las 'khor lo lnga 'phros 'gro ba kun/ /der byas gdod nas grub pa'i lha tshogs dang*/ /lhanacig spyan drangs hūm̐ sogs la thim pas/ hūm̐ aṃ bde chen du gyur bya grub bo/ /zla ba dbyangs gsal hūm̐ aṃ dang bcas las/ /he ru ka dpal yab yum dus gcig du/

/ rdzogs par gyur pa chos dbyings ye shes sam/ /he ru ka dpal gangs ri'i mdog ltar dkar/ /zhal bzhi g.yas bskor dkar dmar ser dang nag/mche gtsigs rdor phreng thod skam lnga lngas brgyan/ /phyag bzhi dang po rdor dril yum la 'khyud/ /'og gnyis thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga yis mtshan/ /thal bas lus byugs phyag rgya drug gis brgyan/ /thod rlon do shal ral pa'i cod pan can/ / g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis dbang phyug dus mtshan rdzis/ /rgyal ba'i sprin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /yum ni drag chen sku mdog zhal phyag rnams/ /yab dang legs mtshungs thod pa'i dum bus brgyan/ /'og dpag sgra sgrogs yab yum phan tshun 'khyud| |rjes chags 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal sngon 'gro bas/ /snyoms par zhugs pa'i 'dod chags chen po yi/ /'od kyi rgyal ba yab yum spyan drangs pa/ /spyi bo nas zhugs byang sems bde chen du/ /zhu ba yum gyi padmar lhung ba las/ /he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa/ /mtshan nyid kun dang ldan pa grub par gyur| |slar yang snyom 'jug dga' ba'i glu dbyangs sgras/ /'dod chags chen po'i lam gyi 'gro ba kun/ /gdul phyir bkug pa slob ma 'jug pa ltar/ / dkyil 'khor der zhugs phyag rgya'i chos 'byung 'od/ /reg pa tsam gyis sgrib pa kun dag nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ru byas par gyur/ /slar yang rgyal ba 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ /yab kyi sku la zhugs pa chags pa'i mes/ /byang sems bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du/ /zhu ba de yis de rnams dbang bskur nas| |phung khams bskyed mched legs par sbyangs pa yis/ /de dag rnams kyi phung khams bskyed mched rnams/ /rnam snang nas bzung padma dra ba'i bar/ /lha yi tshogs dang rdo rje gsum gyi lhas/ /sgo gsum brgyan te mngal gyi dkyil 'khor dang*| |bcas nas dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa gyur/ /rang nyid nam mkha'i nā das yab yum la/ /chags pa'i dga' bas sangs rgyas yab yum gyi/

/sras su skyes nas 'gro don bya snyam pas/ /yab kyi zhal nas zhugs te byang sems dang*// 'dres pa phyag rgya'i padmar lhung nas ni/ /raktar 'dres ma thag tu rjes chags mes| |yab yum gnyis dang lhan cig thig ler ni/ /zhu ba 'od kyi gong bu 'bar bar gyur/ /de la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun 'dus nas/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badzra sa twa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ su ra ta st+waṃ dṛ shya ho/ zhes pa'i glu dbyangs snyan pas bskul ma thag thig le zhu ba hūm̐ dang aṃ du gyur/ /de gnyis rdo rje thod par gyur pa las| |rang nyid dpal ldan bde chen he ru ka /inṭa nī la'i mdog can zhal bzhi pa/ /rtsa zhal nag po drag tu khros pa'i nyams/ /g.yas dkar zhi ba g.yon dmar chags pa'i nyams/ /rgyab zhal gser mdog 'od zer rab tu 'bar/ /re re'ang spyan gsum mche gtsigs ha ha bzhad/ /thod skam lnga lnga rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan| |rab brjid g.yas brkyangs zhabs kyis dus mtshan dang*/ /'jigs byed nu ma rna ba nyi mar brdzis/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis rdor dril yum la 'khyud// de 'og gnyis kyis glang chen lpags rlon gyon/ /gsum pa gnyis kyis gri gug kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhi pa gnyis kyis rtse gsum zhags pa dang*/ /lnga pa gnyis kyis dgra sta thod khrag dang*/ drug pa gnyis kyis rnge chung tshangs mgo 'dzin/ /stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs rgyab tu grol/ /bung ba ltar gnag ral pa'i cod pan rtser// nor bu sna tshogs rdo rje gzi 'od 'bar/ /thal bas lus byugs phyag rgya drug gis brgyan| |mi yi rgyu mar brgyus pa'i mi mgo ni/ /khrag 'dzag lnga bcu phrag par ring du 'phyang*/ /sku nyams sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /gsung nyams rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ /thugs nyams snying rje brngams dang zhi bas brgyan// rdo rje phag mo 'jig dus me ltar 'bar/ /gtum mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yon pas ni/ /bdud bzhi'i khrag dang sgyu mas gang ba yi/

/thod pa bzung nas yab la 'khyud cing stob/ /g.yas pas sdig 'dzub rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ / phyogs bcu'i gdugs pa mtha' dag sdigs par mdzad/ kha nas khrag 'dzag khrag kun lus la byugs/ /byin pa gnyis kyi yab kyi brla la 'khyud/ /gcer mo skra grol thod pa'i dum bus brgyan/ /ha ha bzhad cing spyan gsum rab tu 'bar/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan 'og pags sil sil sgrogs/

/thod skam lnga yis skra mtshams rnam par mdzes/ /thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba'o/ /rang gi zhal bzhi nas g.yon bskor gyi rim pa bzhin du/ oṃ sum bha ni nas badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa| ces pa rnams drag tu gsungs pa'i sngags las khro bo dpag med phyogs bcur spros/ bdud bgegs tshar gcad tshur 'dus zhal bzhi la thim pas byin gyis brlab par gyur/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ glus bskul nas 'di'i bar ni bsnyen pa'o/ /rang gi snying khar zla gdan la rdo rje sems pa'i ngo bo oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor nyi gdan la rnam snang gi ngo bo na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu nyi gdan la padma gar dbang gi ngo bo swāhā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su nyi gdan la dpal he ru ka'i ngo bo ṣaṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su nyi gdan la rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser/ dpral bar nyi gdan la yan lag thams cad kyi rang bzhin rta mchog gi ngo bo phaṭa haṃ ljang khu/ yum gyi lte bar nyi gdan la rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo aṃ baṃ dmar po/ snying khar nyi gdan la gshin rje ma'i ngo bo haṃ yaṃ sngon po/ mgrin par zla gdan la rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo hrī maṃ dkar po/ mgo bor nyi gdan la bskyod byed ma'i ngo bo hrīṃ hrīṃ ser po/ spyi gtsug tu nyi gdan la skrag byed ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ hūm̐ dmar po/ dpral bar nyi gdan la yan lag thams cad kyi lus dbang gi rang bzhin tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ 'di ni nyer ba'i sgrub pa'o/ /yab kyi thugs khar thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin hūm̐ nag po/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa dmar po/ dpral bar sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sa mwa raṃ swāhā dkar po/ thugs rdo rje'i gong du zla gdan la ye shes sems dpa'i rang bzhin rdo rje sngon po rtse mo lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po/

yum gyi thugs kar thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin oṃ sarba bud dha ḍā ki ni badzra warṇa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa nag po/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin oṃ tso ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa dmar po/ dpral bar sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā dkar po/ thugs rdo rje'i gong du zla gdan la ye shes sems dpa'i rang bzhin baṃ dmar po/ yum gyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ snying khar hūm̐ nag po/ lte bar swā ser po/ gsang bar āḥdamar po/ brla gnyis hā ljang khu rnams zhu ba'i 'od zer gyis lus thams cad khyab par gyur/ 'di rnams sgrub pa'o/ /de nas phyag rgya dang blta stangs sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ phaiṃ/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur| oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharmā yo ga shungngho3 haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phaiṃ/ 'khor lo lnga'i dbang gi lha rnams kyang spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba gtabs pas/ sgo mtshams rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad| dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len| yum bzhi phag mo dang lngas phyag g.yon pa'i thod pa cung zad yo bar bzung ste/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur dri ma dag chu lhag ma yongs su gyur pa las yab la mi bskyod pa dang yum la rnam snang gis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams kyang gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ oṃ shrī he ru ka arghaṃ nas shapta pra tī tstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra wī ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

de bzhin du wī ni'i gnas su/ waṃ she smṛ taṃ ge mu ra dze/ lā sye/ hā se/ gī tye/ nṛ tya/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gandhe/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pa badzrī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du ra sa/ sparsha/ dharma dha tu badzri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i yab yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod| |nang mchod shrī he ru ka oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra wā ra hī oṃ āḥhūm̐ rang gi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga bya dmar po las byung pa'i nor bu dmar po rtse mo bya dmar pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las āḥlas byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma gsum rgyā dkar po las byung ba'i lte ba dkar po/ rtse mo rgyā ser pos mtshan pa/ rang gi lte ba snying kha dang*/ yum gyi mgrin pa dang dpral bar zla gdan la oṃbadzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ rgya dpe 'di na ji bzhin yod/ bod mkhas khyad cher 'don pa rnams hūm̐ ring po yin zer phaṭa/ dang*/ oṃ sarba bungngha nas/ swāhā/ rang gi mgrin pa spyi bo dang yum gyi lte ba snying khar nyi gdan la oṃ shrī badzra he he nas swāhā dang*/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dga' bzhi nyams su myong bas zag med bde stong gi ye shes skyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ā tma ko3 haṃ/ de rnams sgrub pa chen po ste/ dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis gdod ma nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor pa 'og min dang*/ 'dzam gling gnas mchog rnams na bzhugs pa'i longs sprul thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang sems mtha' dag dang lhan cig 'khor lo lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs pa mdzod pu'i haṃ yig la thims pas lus thams cas byin gyis brlab par gyur/

yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar te/ haṃ yig zhu ba dhu tī'i nang nas brgyud de rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar babs pa'i theg le cha gnyis su gyur/ cha gcig gzhal yas khang du gyur pa dang*/ dus mnyam du rang gi lus rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur pa ni/ mngal du yaṃ dang rang gi rkang pa gnyis/ /yongs gyur rlung dkyil sngon po gzhu dbyibs can| |raṃ dang sum mdo gru gsum me dkyil dmar/ /baṃ dang lto ba zlum po chu dkyil dkar/ /laṃ dang snying kha gru bzhi sa dkyil ser/ /sum dang rgal tshigs ri rab lhun po ste/ /paṃ dang spyi bo'i rtsa ni padma'o/ /bruṃ dang 'dom gang gru bzhi gzhal yas khang*/ /rkang brgyad ka ba sgo gsum 'khor lo gsum/ /gnyis ka rin chen rtsig pa pha gu sogs/ /mtshan nyid kun dang yang dag ldan par gyur/ / mngal gyi thig le cha gcig sa bon gyi/ /tshogs su gyur te dbus kyi nyi gdan la| |hūm̐ aṃ las byung mi skyod he ru ka /rgyu yi rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu la/ /phag mo drag chen lta bus 'khyud pa yang*/ /rgyan sogs mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs par gyur/ /rang gi snying dbus dhu tī'i hūm̐ yig dpyid/ /nyungs dkar tshad tsam yongs gyur he ru ka /inṭa nī la'i mdog can zhal bzhi pa/ /zhes pa nas/ thugs nyams snying rje brngams dang zhi bas brgyan/ /lte ba'i gtum mo thig le yongs gyur pas/ /rdo rje phag mo 'jig dus me ltar dmar/(nas) /thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba'o/ /de gnyis snying khar phrad nas snyoms zhugs pas// bde stong dbyer med rtogs pa skyes par gyur/ /de 'dra'i phyi nang bde mchog yab yum ni/ /yang dag ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin no/ /mngal gyi pad 'dab kyi phyogs bzhir maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ rnams dang*/ snying kha'i phyogs bzhir 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa 'dab bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma dkar sngon|

byang du lā ma dkar ljang*/ nub tu khaṇḍa ro he dkar dmar/ lhor gzugs can ma dkar ser/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du glang po che dang ce spyang dang mi dang ba lang rnams bcug pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ de bzhi ni rim pa bzhin du lus dang tshor ba dang chos dang sems dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi'i/ mngal gyi mtshams bzhir aṃ dang snying kha'i mtshams kyi mchod pa'i rtsa bzhi yongs su gyur pa las bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa'i steng na sangs rgyas lnga'i gzugs kyis mdzes pa ste/ bde chen gyi 'khor lo'o/ /de bzhin du mngal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rtsibs dang lus kyi gnas nyer bzhir dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams dus gcig tu grub pa ni/ thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i/ /shar rtsibs skra mtshams pu li ma la yar/ /spu dang so sen 'bab pa'i mi phyed ma// yongs gyur 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i dngos/ khaṇḍa ka pā la dang rab gtum ma| |byang rtsibs spyi gtsug dza landha ra ni/ /dza dang skra su 'bab pa'i phreng gzugs ma/ /yongs gyur brtson 'grus rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i dngos/ /mahā kaṃ ka la dang gtum mig ma/ /nub rtsibs rna g.yas o ḍe ya nar ni/ /aṃ dang dri ma 'bab pa'i rtse ba ma/ /yongs gyur spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i dngos/ /dpa' bo kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ /lho rtsibs ltag pa ar bu ta zhes byar/ /a dang sha chen 'bab pa'i g.yon pa ma/ /yongs gyur sems kyi rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i dngos| |mche ba rnam par gtsigs dang sna chen ma/ /'di dag gnas yin rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /me rtsibs rna ba g.yon pa go da war/ /go dang chu rgyus 'bab pa'i thung ngu ma/ /yongs gyur chang dgra dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ /bden bral smin mtshams rā me shrā rar ni/ /ra dang rus pa 'babs pa'i rus sbal ma/ /yongs gyur 'od dpag med dang kharba rī/

/rlung rtsibs mig gnyis de wi ko ṭar ni/ /de dang mchin pa 'bab pa'i sgom pa ma/ /yongs gyur rdor 'od lang ga'i dbang phyug ma| |dbang ldan phrag pa mā la wa zhes bya/ /ma dang dri chu 'bab pa'i dbang ma ni| |yongs gyur rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma/ /de rnams rim bzhin dad pa brtson 'grus dang*/ /dran pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin dngos/ /nye ba'i gnas yin dri ma med pa'i sa/ /kun kyang mkha' la spyod pa'i spyod tshul gyis/ /rab bzhugs inṭa nī la'i mdog can no/ /gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i/ /shar rtsibs 'chan khung kā ma ru par ni/ /ka dang mig dbang 'bab pa'i skyon ldan ma/ /yongs gyur myu gu can dang sa bsrungs ma/ /byang rtsibs nu ma zung ni oṭṭi ru/ /o dang mkhris pa 'bab pa'i 'jug pa ma/ / yongs gyur rdo rje ral pa 'jigs chen ma/ /de gnyis rim bzhin shes rab dbang po dang*/ /dad pa'i stobs te zhing yin 'od byed sa/ /nub rtsibs lte ba tri sha ku ner ni/ /dri dang glo ba 'babs pa'i ma mo ma/ /yongs gyur dpa' bo che dang rlung shugs ma/ /lho rtsibs dang ni sna rtse ko sha lar/ /ko dang sgyu ma 'babs pa'i mtshan rgyu ma/ /yongs gyur rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad chang 'thung ma/ /de gnyis rim bzhin brtson 'grus dran pa'i stobs/ /nye ba'i zhing yin bzhi pa 'od 'phro'o/ /me yi rtsibs dang kha ni liṃ kar/ /ka dang logs gnyis 'bab pa'i bsil sbyin ma// yongs gyur rab tu bzang dang sngo bsangs ma/ /bden bral rtsibs dang mgrin pa lam pā kar/ /la dang lto ba 'bab pa'i mtshan mo ma/ /yongs gyur rdor bzang shin tu bzang mo'o/ /de gnyis rim bzhin ting 'dzin shes rab stobs/ /tshan dho ha te lnga pa sbyangs ka'i sa/ /rlung gi rtsibs dang snying kha kāñtsir ni/ /ka dang gshang ba 'bab pa'i mtshan mo ma/ /yongs gyur 'jigs byed chen po rta rna ma/ /dbang ldan 'bras bu hi mā la yar ni/ /hi dang 'tshogs srubs 'bab pa'i ngang gdong ma|

|yongs gyur mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma/ /de dag rim bzhin ting 'dzin brtson 'grus kyi/ /byang chub yan lag rang bzhin nye ba yi/ /tshan dho ha ste mngon du gyur pa'o/ /kun kyang sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /rab bzhugs padma rā ga'i mdog can no/ /sku yi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i/ /shar rtsibs mtshan ma pre ta pū rir ni/ /pre dang bad kan 'bab pa'i gzugs can ma// yongs gyur stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs/ /byang rtsibs bshang lam gṛ ha de wa tar/ /dri dang rtag tu rnag 'bab spyi ma ni/ /yongs gyur rin chen rdo rje dum skyes ma/ /de gnyis rim bzhin dga' dang shin sbyangs kyi/ /byang chub yan lag 'du ba ring du song/ /nub rtsibs brla gnyis se'u ra ṭar ni/ /so dang khrag rgyun 'bab pa'i rgyu sbyin ma/ /yongs gyur rta mgrin dang ni chang 'tshong ma/ /lho rtsibs byin pa gser gling zhes bya bar/ /su dang dngul chu 'bab pa'i sbyor bral ma/ / yongs gyur mkha' snying 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ /de dag chos rab 'byed dang dran pa yi/ /byang chub yan lag nye 'du mi g.yo'i sa/ /me rtsibs sor mo bcu drug na ga rar/ /na dang tshil bu 'bab pa'i sdu gu ma/ /yongs gyur he ru ka dpal rab dpa' mo/ /bden bral rtsibs dang bol gong sin dur ni/ /si dang mchil la 'bab pa'i grub ma ni/ /yongs gyur padma gar dbang stobs chen ma/ /de dag btang snyoms byang yan yang dag lta/ /dur khrod ces bya legs pa'i blo gros so/ / rlung gi rtsibs dang mtho 'ong ma rur ni/ /ma dang mchil ma 'bab pa'i 'tshed pa ma| |yongs gyur rnam snang mdzad dang 'khor lo bsgyur/ /dbang ldan rtsibs dang pu mo ku la tar/ /ku dang ngar brnabs 'bab pa'i yid bzang ma/ /yongs gyur rdor sems brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ /de dag yang dag lta dang yang dag ngag |nye ba'i dur khrod ces bya chos kyi sprin/ /kun kyang sa 'og spyod pa'i tshul gyis ni/

/rab bzhugs ku mud ta ltar dkar ba'o/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga'/ /dpa' bo ral pa'i thor btsugs rdor dril 'dzin/ / he ru ka dang mtshungs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /ro dang nyi mar g.yas rkyangs zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /dpa' mo skra grol gcer mo gri thod 'dzin/ /rdo rje phag mo'i khyad par kun dang ldan/ /shar nas g.yon bskor khang bzang sgo bzhi dang*/ /me nas g.yas bskor mtshams bzhir hūm̐ brgyad dang*/ kha lte'i rtsa dang sna bug g.yon gyi rtsa| |bshang gci'i rtsa dang sna bug g.yas kyi rtsa/ /rna ba g.yas g.yon mig bu g.yas g.yon gyi/ /rtsa rnams yongs gyur kha gdong 'ug gdong ma/ khyi gdong phag gdong gshin rje'i brtan ma dang*/ /pho nya mo dang mche ba 'joms ma rnams/ / phyogs ma phyogs mdog mtshams ma phyed gzugs can/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas gri gug 'phyar/ /g.yon pas thod khrag thugs khar 'dzin pa yi| |gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga ni legs par brten/ /de brgyad rim bzhin yang dag las mtha' dang*/ /'tsho ba rtsol ba dran pa rnams dang ni/ /dge ba ma bskyed bskyed dang skyes pa spel/ /sdig pa skyes pa spong zhing ma skyes pa/ /bsrung ba'i yang dag spong ba bzhi rnams yin/ /snying po rnal 'byor ma dang bcas pa yi/ /lha mo bcu gnyis g.yas rkyang gar gyis ni/

/ro dang nyi ma'i gdan la rnam par 'gying*| |gcer mo skra ser gyen brdzes spyan gsum dmar/ /phyag rgya lnga dang 'og pags dril bu 'khrol/ /dbu la zla phyed rdo rje rtse lnga dang*/ /thod skam lngas brgyan lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang*/ /gtso 'khor kun kyang 'od zer 'bar zhing 'phro/ khro gnyer 'khyug cing khro chags zur mig can/ /yab kun yum gyi nu ma 'tshir la brtson| |gar dgu'i nyams kyis rnam par brgyan pa'o/ /de ltar gsal la rdzogs pa'i mngal gyi dkyil 'khor rnams rang gi thugs khar drangs/ hūm̐ aṃ maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ/ pu dza o a go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gṛ sau su na si ma ku/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ rnams kyis thugs kha nas phyir spros/ rang rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ 'gro ba thams cad 'khor lo lnga'i go 'phangs la bkod slar 'dus nas gtso bo yab yum rang la gnyis su med par thim zhing*/ 'khor gyi lha rnams thod pa dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma nas dam tshig 'khor lo'i byang shar gyi bar rang rang gi gdan la mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gsal la rdzogs par 'khod par gyur/ bruṃ gzhal yas khang phyir spros/ snod kyi 'jig rten sbyangs/ phyi'i gzhal yas khang la thim| de yan chad ni bsnyen pa'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad kyi snying khar zla gdan la rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo zhes pa nas phaṭa haṃ ljang khu dpa' mo thams cad kyi snying kha lte bar nyi gdan la/ zhes pa nas phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan zhing*| thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po mgrin par āḥdamar po thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ yum rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ snying khar hūm̐/ lte bar swā/ gsang bar āḥ/ 'di ni nye ba'i sgrub pa'o/ /de nas ye shes dgug zhugs dang dbang bskur rgyas btab la sogs la spro na mchod pa yang 'bul/ brla'i rtsa bar hā ljang khu rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/

phaiṃ rang gi zhes pa nas chu lhag ma las grub pa'i mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhi la rin 'byung*/ thugs 'khor la mi skyod pa/ gsung 'khor la snang mtha'/ sku 'khor la rnam snang*/ dam tshig 'khor lo'i lha rnams la don grub kyis dbu brgyan par gyur cing dbang gi lha rnams kyang gnyis su med par thim par gyur to/ /'di yan sgrub pa yin la sngags kyis bstod pa na| bsgrub chen du gsungs so/ /de nas lha thams cad gsal 'debs pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ badzra rdo rje he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba'i sdoms pa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la samba ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa rdo rje rnam par snang byed ma la/ nī ye ma la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ḍā mkha' 'gro ma kī nī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ khaṇḍa ro he dum skyes ma/ ka ra byed byed ka ra pra tsaṇḍe rab gtum ma/ ku ru ku ru mdzod gnyis tsaṇḍa akṣi ye gtum mig ma/ bandha bandha chings gnyis pra bhā wa tī ye 'od ldan la/ trā sa ya trā sa ya skrag par gyis gnyis ma hā nā se sna chen ma/ kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya bskyod par gyis gnyis/ bī ra ma tī ye dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ hroṃ hroṃ kharb+ba rī ye le'u thung ma/ hraṃ hraṃ laṅke shwa rī ye lang ga'i dbang phyug ma la/ pheṃ pheṃ dru matstsha ye shing grib ma la/ phaṭa phaṭa ai rā wa tī ye/ da ha da ha ma hā bhai ra wī ye bsregs gnyis 'jigs byed chen mo/ pa tsa pa tsa wā yu we ge tshams ma gnyis rlung shugs ma la/ bha kṣa bha kṣa zo zo wa sa zhag tu dhi ra khrag anta mā la rgyu ma'i phreng ba 'phyang ba a wa lambi ne su rā bha kṣī ye chang 'thung ma| gṛhna gṛhna sapta pā tā a ga ta bhu dzaṅga sarp+paṃ wā tardzdza ya tardzdza ya gnas pa'i lag ma sdigs srin gnyis/ shyā mā de wī ye sngo bsangs lha mo la/ ā ga ḍa ḍhya ya tardzdza yasu bha dre rab tu bzang mo la/

hrī hrī ha ya karṇ+ṇe rta'i rna ba ma/ dzñeṃ dzñeṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kha gā na ne bya gdong ma/ kṣ+mā kṣ+mā tsakra be ge 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ hāṃ hāṃ khaṇḍa ro he dum skyes ma/ hīṃ hīṃ shaiṇḍi nī ye chang 'tshong ma/ tsakrawarm+mi ṇī ye 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ kī li kī la su wī re shin tu dpa' mo/ si li si la ma hā ba le stobs mo che ma/ hi li hi la tsa kra wart+ti nī ye 'khor los bsgyur ma/ dhi li dhi li ma hā bīdye brtson 'grus chen mo/ kā kā dye bya gdong ma/ u lu kā sye 'ug gdong ma/ shwā nā sye khyi gdong ma/ pū ka rā sye phag gdong ma/ ya ma dā dhi ye gshin rje brtan ma/ ya ma daṣti ṇī ye gshin rje mche ba ma/ ya ma ma tha nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa gshin rje 'joms ma/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad dang gzugs sogs 'dod yon lnga dang bde ba'i longs spyod bsdus/ zhal nas zhugs pa rjes chags kyi mes zhu ste/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar 'bab pa'i byang chub kyi sems de rnams mchod pa'i lha mo dang mchod rdzas dpag tu med par gyur pa rnams sbyor mtshams nas byung ste/ lha thams cad mchod pas mnyes par gyur| oṃ shrī he ru ka tsakra sarba ra maṇḍa la tsakra sarb+ba wī rā yo gi nī arghaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hā| nas/ oṃ dharma dha tu badzrī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo/ dge legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ dngos grub thams cad kyi gter mdzod| drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /phyag rdor sa ra ha dang klu sgrub zhabs/ /ri khrod dbang phyug lo hi dā ri ka /dril bu rus sbal zhabs dang rgyal ba 'dzin/ /nag po spyod pa gu hya rnam rgyal zhabs/ /tai lo nā ro phaṃ 'thing sku mched dang*/ /klog skya mal gyo sa chen bsod rtse'i zhabs/

/rje btsun sa paṇa 'phags pa dkon mchog dpal/ /bsod dpal bsod rgyal byang rtse grags rgyal dang*/ /dpal ldan 'jigs med grags pa la sogs pa/ /bde mchog brgyud pa'i bla mar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /de bzhin du lha rnams kyi mtshan gyi mthar yang sbyar zhing*/ yi dam chos skyong gzhan dang dur khrod kyi phyogs skyong zhing skyong sogs la'ang 'bul lo/ /sngar bzhin snyoms 'jug dang bde stong gi de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa byas la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du mgor bor oṃ dang*/ mthar hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar la/ ma hā kalpa agni saṃ ni bhā ya/ dza ṭā ma ku ṭa utka ṭa ya/ daṃṣta ka ra lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ sa hā sra byu dza bhā su ra ya/ pa ra shu pā sho dya ta shū la kha ṭwāṃ ga dha ri ṇe/ byā ghra a dzi na amba ra dharā ya/ mahā dhumm+rāndha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ yum gyi rkang brgyad kyang gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin bstod do/ /rdzogs rim rim pa bzhi pa ni gzhan du shes par bya la/ bskyed rim lha'i rnal 'byor la gsal snang thon zhing brtan pa thob thob kyi bar du bsgom mo/ /mnyam gzhag gi skyo na/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kha'i hūm̐ yig gi nā da las 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs spros/ 'gro ba thams cad bde mchog gi go 'phangs la bkod/ slar 'dus nas hūm̐ yig gi nā da la thim pa'i spro bsdu'i mdzad pa can du gyur par bsam la/ snying po'i yi ge nyer gnyis pa dang*/ nye snying bdun pa dang*/ snying po'i nye snying zhal bzhi pa'i sngags dang*/ dpa' bo nyer bzhi'i ka ra ka ra sogs kyi sngon du rkang brgyad sbyar zhing*| kun gyi mgor oṃ dang mthar hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa tshar gcig sbyar ba rtsa sngags dang*/ sarba bungngha sogs snying po dang*/ bai ro tsa nī sogs nye snying dang*/ tsaurwi snying po'i nye snying dang*/ yang rkang brgyad dang bcas pa'i/ tatya thā pro taṃ ke sogs yum gyi rtsa sngags dang*/

'khor rnams kyi gong du brjod pa bzhin brgya rtsa la sogs pa dung chen gyi phreng ba byin gyis brlabs te bzlas la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis snod bcud dur khrod dang*/ de rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ de dam tshigasku gsung thugs bde chen 'khor lo rnams rim pa bzhin du la dang*/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi phag mo dang bcas pa gtso bo la dang*/ de'i lus dkyil rnams kyang rim gyis bsdus te mthar snying gi nang nas dpyid hūm̐ yig la thim zhing*/ rang gi gzhi lus kyang ye shes sems dpa' hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thim pa'i hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu lus lus mgo bo zla tshes dang thig le nā da rnams rim gyi thim zhing nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāktsitta badzra swa bhā wātma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shungngha sarba dharma yo ga shungngho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis dpal ldan he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa la/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'i snying khar zla gdan la zhes sogs kyis go cha bcu gnyis bkod rang gi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyer bzhir nyi gdan la pu dza o aḥnas/ ma ku rnams thig les brgyan pas mtshan par gyur/ oṃ suṃ bha ni nas/ badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod nas/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug cing gtor ma gtong na'ang nang mchod ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ phaiṃ/ dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i 'khor lo bsdom pa'i dkyil 'khor ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa mdun du spyan drangs/ 'gron rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badzra a ra li hoḥ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya st+raṃ dṛ shya ho/

badzra ḍā ki nī/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa rākṣa sa/ byū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ unmā ta/ a pasmā ra/ ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ/ gṛhṇantu sa ma yaṃ/ rakṣantu ma ma sarba singnghi me/ pra yatstshantu/ ya thai waṃ/ ya theṣṭhaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pī wa tha/ dzi ghra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra yā/ sat+su khaṃ bi shungnghe sa hā ye kā bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pheṃ pheṃ zhes pa tshar lngas g.yon bskor gyi rdo rje thal mo gyen du phye bas dbul zhing*/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byas la/ 'dod don la gsol ba btabs nas/ gtor 'gron ye shes pa pad bskor dang bcas pas 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ yo ga shwangnghas rang la bsdu zhing*/ 'jig rten pa rnams badzra muḥ/ rang gnas su gshegs par gyur par bsam mo/ kha zas kyang gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs shing*/ lce yang byin gyis brlabs nas lus dkyil gyi lha mnyes phyir du g.yon pa'i kun spyod kyis bza'o/ khrus ni dbang bskur ltar bya la/ nyal ba'i tshe snod bcud thams cad kyang rang yab yum la bsdus zhing*/ yum yab dang thugs kha'i hūm̐ dang*| hūm̐ yang sngar bzhin bsdus la/ 'od gsal gyi ngang la nyal nas tho rangs mkha' 'gro mas cang te'u sgra dang glus bskul nas sad par mos te/ sngar bzhin du nyams su blang ngo/ / dpal ldan sdom pa nag po'i gzhung bzhin du/ /legs par bsgrubs pa'i nyams len nyung 'dus 'di/ /shākya'i dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis/ /rang gzhan don du lhag bsam dag pas sbyar/ /nongs pa bla ma lhar bcas mkhas rnams la/ /'gyod pas gshags bgyi bzod pa bzhes pa dang*/ / dge bas rang gzhan mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub che la rtag tu rol bar shog |'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mtha' dag dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/bde mchog nag po spyod pa'i sgrub thabs snying po bde 'jug
